I see no reason [against] TypeScript then. For the [store is] absolutely simple, that it requires almost no bytes written purely. Do you mean to say that 4 and 5 are shortcuts? That we're not properly building the interface first? Because I want everything well done. When I arrive. For if there is no reason to shortcut what we're doing, then we might as well build it with quality. You are to combine both rigorousness and freedom. That is there will be a job that for every finished thing there always spawns a new agent to take its angle.

Sorry, was my transcription bad? Would you tell me why you [recommend] to move now to Rust from TypeScript.

Good. Then the transcription was wrong and we're now aligned.
body.title: Well done when I arrive
